messages.subject: SEAFCO | Foundation engineering, sustainability and project stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Dr. Narong Thasnanipan and SEAFCO Leadership Team,

SEAFCO's role as a specialist foundation engineering company supporting Thailand's infrastructure growth makes stakeholder and institutional execution an important complement to technical capability.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy across a major industrial operation.

I bring experience managing approvals, official engagements, community priorities and cross-functional follow-through in a setting where technical execution and external trust are closely linked. I also support renewable-energy and carbon-governance initiatives, adding a broader sustainability perspective.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or project stakeholder leadership. I have attached a SEAFCO-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
